test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain amount of money was lent for a period of 1 year 9 months at a rate of 10% per annum compounded annually. If the compound interest is ₹1,460, find the amount of money lent.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Rate for the **first year** = 10%.

Rate for the remaining **9 months** (3/4 year) = 10% × 3/4 = 7.5%.

**Effective CI Rate** = 10 + 7.5 + (10 × 7.5) ÷ 100 = 18.25%.

Given CI = ₹1,460 → 18.25% of Principal = 1,460.

**Principal (100%)** = (1,460 ÷ 18.25) × 100 = ₹8,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Time (T)** = 1 year 9 months = 1 (9/12) years = 1.75 years.

**Rate (R)** = 10% per annum.

**Compound Interest (CI)** = ₹1,460.

**Formula Used:**

For fractional years (n + a/b), Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ × [1 + (R × a/b)/100]

CI = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e35e7bbc45a08f2f7de4f615c6cbfa6689053838b7a78bf50dd7c9e4413c98d9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount (A) = P × (1 + 10/100)¹ × [1 + (10 × 9/12)/100]

⇒ A = P × (11/10) × [1 + (10 × 3/4)/100]

⇒ A = P × (1.1) × (1 + 7.5/100)

⇒ A = P × 1.1 × 1.075

⇒ A = 1.1825P

⇒ CI = A − P = 1.1825P − P = 0.1825P

⇒ 0.1825P = 1460

⇒ P = 1460 ÷ 0.1825

⇒ P = (1460 × 10000) ÷ 1825

⇒ P = 8000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

For two successive rates r₁% and r₂%, the **effective rate** is given by [r₁ + r₂ + (r₁ × r₂) ÷ 100]%.

Effective Rate for Fractional Time

When time is in the form T = n + f (where f is a fraction), the rate for the **fractional part** of the year is R × f.

Amount Formula

Standard CI Amount: A = P(1 + r/100)t. For **annual compounding**, interest is added to the principal at the end of each year.
